channel.title: The Lowndes Signal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lowndes Signal (lowndessignal.com)

item.title: AHSAA reclassification reunites Calhoun, Central
item.description: AHSAA’s new 6-class public and 2-division private system reunites Calhoun and Central in 1A Region 4 and separates public and private schools for postseason titles starting 2026-27.

item.title: Correction: Pose for Purpose
item.description: In the article, "Runway show supports Lowndes Middle School" which published in the Jan. 22 issue of The Lowndes Signal, models Malaysia Mitchell and Amber McMeans should have been identified as they are in these photos. We apologize for the error and are happy to make the correction. Amber McMeans models in the Pose for Purpose Fashion Show. Photo by Keldrick Purifoy | THE LOWNDES SIGNAL Malaysia Mitchell models in the Pose for Purpose Fashion Show. Photo by Keldrick Purifoy | THE LOWNDES SIGNA

item.title: Show us your trash Fort Deposit
item.description: Fort Deposit residents are joining a town-wide cleanup, from Old Fort Road to Coleman Street. Share your trash pickup photos and locations to be highlighted.

item.title: Listen to a mouthy friend
item.description: Feel trapped in a hopeless life? This column urges you to invite an honest friend to assess your choices, reveal needed changes, and help you find hope or a new direction.

item.title: Fort Deposit moves ahead with swearing in, runoff
item.description: Fort Deposit will swear in its new mayor and council Feb. 2, while a tied District 2 race heads to a Feb. 17 runoff after a recount confirmed the vote deadlock.

item.title: Alabama expands school choice with tax credit
item.description: Alabama joins the Federal Education Freedom Tax Credit program under Gov. Ivey’s order, expanding school choice and tax-credit scholarships starting in 2027.

item.title: What's Happening Lowndes County
item.description: From food safety workshops to free Pre-K, new Fort Deposit officials, parenting support, veteran meetups and weather prep, here’s what’s happening across Lowndes County.

item.title: Hamit wins Athlete of the Week
item.description: Lowndes Academy sophomore Lillian Hamit earns Lowndes County Athlete of the Week, winning 42% of 558 votes in round 19 of the 2025-26 season.

item.title: The art of interviewing poorly
item.description: A humorously bad-interview guide morphs into real advice on handling nerves, preparation, and what to wear before a job interview you really want.

item.title: Locals commended on UWA honors lists
item.description: Lowndes County students Marquis Brown, Elliott Owen and Sophie Phillips earn spots on UWA's fall 2025 Dean's and President's lists for academic excellence.
